title: 0.2.18 install reliability update
summary: This update improves overwrite install reliability, first-run feedback, launcher VersionInfo, and Cadence integration visibility.
highlights: Overwrite setup now stops running Insta360_HW services before replacing files, reducing file-lock failures.
Downgrade installs warn when a newer version is already registered.
First run stores the readiness marker under LOCALAPPDATA and opens a waiting page while initialization runs.
compatibility: No data migration is required. Existing history, user plugins and local config are preserved.
